page.notes: Cut-off right side; the entries continue beyond the visible edge. Blue entries are handwritten-looking marks in colour print; page numbers are underlined. Some letters are doubtful, e.g. "Kare la queiib" and "Ketannot" may be corrupt in print. Right-hand page numbers in blue are references, printed as links in the scan; the word "consideIrantur" is a probable misprint for "considerantur". The foot line "Xxx 3" is a signature and "--- non" the start of the next entry.
